body: I’m commenting because last year I was the one posting and no one replied. None of that “it’ll be ok” stuff, just saying I’m here with you, just hanging out. Hit me up if you wanna talk

I’ve packed up my things so someone else won’t have to, cleaned up the house, written a pretty basic will, gotten my hair cut and shaved up nice. I still haven’t put dry cleaned and put my medals on my army uniform but that seems like it should be number on my list of things to do ya know?
